title: ‘Your Friends & Neighbors’ star confirmed for third Apple TV project - 9to5Mac
summary: Actor James Marsden, who recently played billionaire Owen Ashe in the second season of Your Friends & Neighbors , was confirmed this week for his Apple TV third production. Like on Disavowed, Marsden will also act as executive producer.
